description: Unit test code for proxy configuration in Chromium project, including helper functions and class for testing proxy rules expectations.

classes.name: ProxyRulesExpectation
classes.description: Class representing expected proxy rules for testing purposes.

methods.name: Matches
methods.description: Compares actual proxy rules against expected rules, returning assertion result.

methods.name: Empty
methods.description: Creates an expectation for empty proxy rules.

methods.name: EmptyWithBypass
methods.description: Creates an expectation for empty proxy rules with specific bypass rules.

methods.name: Single
methods.description: Creates an expectation for a single proxy with bypass rules.

methods.name: PerScheme
methods.description: Creates an expectation for per-scheme proxy rules.

methods.name: PerSchemeWithSocks
methods.description: Creates an expectation for per-scheme proxy rules including SOCKS proxy.

methods.name: PerSchemeWithBypassReversed
methods.description: Creates an expectation for per-scheme proxy rules with reversed bypass.
